items.title: Poonawalla Fincorp shares rally 25% in three weeks: What’s driving the surge?
items.description: Poonawalla Fincorp's stock has gained over 25% since late October due to strong quarterly performance. Recent fundraising efforts of ₹2,000 crore have further boosted investor confidence and price targets. As portfolio yields improve, overall profitability and margin expansion are anticipated in the coming years. Digital personal loans and other products are expected to contribute significantly to future growth.

items.title: P&G India FY26 show stays subdued, profit falls 2.7%
items.description: Procter & Gamble Home Products experienced a 3.4% revenue increase to ₹9,359 crore in fiscal year 2026. Its net profit fell by 2.7% to ₹665 crore during the same period. Competition in the household and personal care markets has intensified, affecting revenue growth. The company's broader Indian operations posted a revenue rise to ₹16,749 crore, reflecting mixed results. Hindustan Unilever's performance remains above P&G's growth metrics, indicating tough market conditions.
